incidents.name: iVest donation-on-burn double debit
incidents.notes: Transfers to the zero address trigger the token's _MakeDonation path, which debits the sender's balance a second time; repeatedly sending iVest to the PancakeSwap pair and calling skim/sync shrank the pair's token reserve and let the attacker swap the reserve out for WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: iVest token 0x786fcf76... created by 0x3421d514fcd2cf1303bc13d88bcb3e75e8032642 on 2024-06-15, no upgrade events; attack sender 0x46458632... unrelated to the creator; loss uses the $156k QuillAudits figure
